observations.behavior: Adds CloseSearchError to the imports, and P1.F1.H2 wraps the warehouse search call in a try/except block, catching CloseSearchError and checking if the error message contains 'list is too long'. If the list is too long, it logs a warning and retries the search using only standard fields instead of the combined fields. P1.F2.H1 adds a test asserting this fallback behavior.
observations.posthog_connection: This could prevent warehouse ingestion failures for Close accounts with many custom fields, allowing the warehouse connector to complete the sync rather than permanently failing. This could help PostHog users who rely on Close data and have accounts with many custom fields.
